capabilityFindings.title: Intended purpose or decision context is not specific, bounded and testable
capabilityFindings.lifecycleConsequence: Do not progress to consequential verification, deployment or expansion until the purpose and decision role are bounded and human-validated.

capabilityFindings.title: User, affected-person or permitted/prohibited-use boundary is incomplete
capabilityFindings.lifecycleConsequence: Constrain scope to evidenced users and uses; require boundary completion before deployment to unassessed groups or contexts.

capabilityFindings.title: Implemented system behavior diverges from the approved purpose boundary
capabilityFindings.lifecycleConsequence: Stop or constrain the divergent path until deterministic controls and accountable authorization align implementation with the approved boundary.

capabilityFindings.title: Evaluation or operating evidence does not establish boundary effectiveness
capabilityFindings.lifecycleConsequence: Do not claim effective boundary control; require representative testing and current operating evidence before the target transition.

capabilityFindings.title: Material scope change has not been requalified and authorized
capabilityFindings.lifecycleConsequence: Prevent or suspend the expanded use pending impact analysis, reassessment and formal authorization.

antipatternFindings.title: Purpose is vague, general-purpose or technically framed without a testable decision context
antipatternFindings.lifecycleConsequence: Prevent consequential progression until a system-specific purpose and decision context are approved.

antipatternFindings.title: Purpose statements conflict or omit material users, affected persons, permitted or prohibited uses
antipatternFindings.lifecycleConsequence: Constrain the system to the narrowest evidenced boundary and require authoritative reconciliation.

antipatternFindings.title: Reachable implementation or operations exceed the approved purpose boundary
antipatternFindings.lifecycleConsequence: Stop or disable the divergent path until controls and authorization restore alignment.

antipatternFindings.title: Purpose or use scope expanded without requalification and authorization
antipatternFindings.lifecycleConsequence: Suspend the expanded use and require material-change reassessment and formal decision.

antipatternFindings.title: Absence of undefined or elastic purpose is not established by a scoped current test
antipatternFindings.lifecycleConsequence: Do not report TESTED_ABSENT; retain UNKNOWN until the complete absence-test contract is satisfied.
